title: Tech
description: Researched by a player and held in a Lab: it unlocks units and buildings, and gives effects, while held. See docs/specs/tech-spec.md.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

faction.description: The Faction that can research it; left out, every Faction can.

field.description: The Research field it's researched in, from the Ruleset's.

requires.title: Tech Requirements
requires.description: Offered only once the player holds every Tech and owns every building listed.

unlocks.title: Tech Unlocks
unlocks.description: Anything listed here, by any Tech, can be queued only while a Tech unlocking it is held.
